title: Exact-Head Truth Contract
description: Canonical CI/execution status record. No status counts as truth unless it binds to an exact commit SHA, run identity, and timestamp. Stale or unbound statuses are rejected.

sha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA this status binds to

run_id.description: Unique execution identifier (CI run ID, WORKS work ID, or UUID)

attempt.description: Attempt number for this run_id (retries increment)

timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp when this status was recorded

source.description: Origin system that produced this status

freshness_window_seconds.description: Maximum age in seconds before this status is considered stale (optional, default 3600)
